disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码、客户端代码与构建配置中读取敏感信息的位置：未发现读取本机凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云厂商密钥或环境变量中密钥的任何代码路径。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code, client code, and build configuration for locations that read sensitive information: no code paths were found that read local credential files, SSH private keys, cloud provider keys, or secrets from environment variables.

checked_items.zh: 检查了代码中硬编码密钥与口令的情况：未发现，静态预扫也未命中相关模式。
checked_items.en: Checked for hardcoded credentials and passwords in the code: none found, and static pre-scan did not hit any related patterns.

checked_items.zh: 客户端皮肤代码只操作页面 DOM 属性、样式变量与内嵌图片，不接触任何凭据存储面。
checked_items.en: The client skin code only manipulates page DOM attributes, style variables, and embedded images, and does not touch any credential storage surface.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取本机凭据文件或敏感目录的代码路径：客户端代码仅做 DOM 装饰与样式写入（src/client/index.ts、src/client/customization.ts），无任何敏感路径读取。外联通道面在 DG-D4 核查。
evidence.en: No code paths reading local credential files or sensitive directories found: the client code only performs DOM decoration and style writing (src/client/index.ts, src/client/customization.ts), with no sensitive path reads. The outbound channel surface is checked in DG-D4.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件注册的工具描述与系统提示词注入点：本插件不注册任何工具、不注入任何系统提示词段落，不存在工具描述投毒面。
checked_items.en: Checked the tool descriptions registered by the plugin and system prompt injection points: this plugin does not register any tools, does not inject any system prompt paragraphs, and there is no tool description poisoning surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了模型面指令文件（技能说明、代理指令、编辑器指令等）：审计树内不存在此类文件。
checked_items.en: Checked model-side instruction files (skill descriptions, agent instructions, editor instructions, etc.): no such files exist within the audit tree.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库文档与注释中的注入措辞与外部指令引用：文档中的链接均为素材署名来源与正常安装说明，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息或诱导模型二次拉取的文字。
checked_items.en: Checked for injection wording and external instruction references in repository documentation and comments: the links in the documentation are all material attribution sources and normal installation instructions; no text was found that overrides instructions, masquerades as system messages, or induces the model to perform secondary pulls.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何工具、不注入系统提示词段落（src/client/index.ts 中无工具注册或提示词注入调用），无工具描述可投毒。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any tools, does not inject system prompt paragraphs (no tool registration or prompt injection calls in src/client/index.ts), and has no tool descriptions that can be poisoned.

evidence.zh: 没有工具描述面可诱导安装或改写配置；仓库文档仅含正常安装说明（README.md:15-19），无诱导性措辞。
evidence.en: There is no tool description surface that can induce installation or rewrite configuration; the repository documentation only contains normal installation instructions (README.md:15-19), with no misleading wording.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型输入守门事件，无改写或注入用户消息的代码面。
evidence.en: No model input gate events are listened to, and there is no code surface that rewrites or injects user messages.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态代码执行面（脚本求值、动态函数构造、子进程调用）：全部源码与构建配置中未发现此类调用。
checked_items.en: Checked the dynamic code execution surface (script evaluation, dynamic function construction, subprocess invocation): no such calls found in all source code and build configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置中的可执行 YAML 标量：全树扫描未命中，挂载配置仅登记客户端入口。
checked_items.en: Checked for executable YAML scalars in the patch configuration: full tree scan did not hit, the patch configuration only registers the client entry point.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子与构建期执行载体：包声明无安装/构建钩子，树内无 CI 工作流、Git 钩子、开发容器、Makefile 等执行载体。
checked_items.en: Checked for install hooks and build-time execution carriers: the package declaration has no install/build hooks, and there are no CI workflows, Git hooks, dev containers, Makefiles, or other execution carriers within the tree.

checked_items.zh: 客户端包声明为自动加载，其内容已逐文件审查：仅做页面样式装饰，不含键盘/剪贴板监听、凭证调用或外联请求。
checked_items.en: The client package is declared as auto-load, and its contents have been reviewed file by file: it only performs page style decoration, and does not contain keyboard/clipboard listeners, credential calls, or outbound requests.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 登记客户端入口（cordis.patch.yml:5-7），不含可执行 YAML 标量；全树扫描未命中此类标量。
evidence.en: The patch configuration cordis.patch.yml contains only a single insert line registering the client entry point (cordis.patch.yml:5-7), and contains no executable YAML scalars; full tree scan did not hit such scalars.

evidence.zh: 源码中无动态包工具调用，无宿主内脚本执行面。
evidence.en: There are no dynamic package tool calls in the source code, and no host-internal script execution surface.

evidence.zh: package.json 的脚本仅含 build 与 test（package.json:23-26），无安装/构建钩子；树内无 CI 工作流、Git 钩子等执行载体。
evidence.en: The scripts in package.json only contain build and test (package.json:23-26), with no install/build hooks; there are no CI workflows, Git hooks, or other execution carriers within the tree.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明客户端包（package.json:18-21）；客户端 bundle 已通过其对应源码审查：只做页面装饰，无键盘/剪贴板监听与凭证 RPC 调用（lib/client.js 头部为 dsh 标准模块加载器，src/client/index.ts 全文已读）。
evidence.en: The manifest declares the client package (package.json:18-21); the client bundle has been reviewed through its corresponding source code: it only performs page decoration, with no keyboard/clipboard listeners or credential RPC calls (the header of lib/client.js is the dsh standard module loader, and the full content of src/client/index.ts has been read).

evidence.zh: 未注册子代理提供方，无进程外委派面。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider registered, no out-of-process delegation surface.

evidence.zh: 未使用 dsh 后台任务、定时、持久目标等持驻机制，也未监听轮次终止事件。
evidence.en: No use of dsh background tasks, timers, persistent targets, or other persistence mechanisms, and no listening for round termination events.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部网络外联通道（网络请求、WebSocket、信标上报等）：源码与客户端代码中均无任何网络调用；代码中仅有的 http 字样是内嵌 SVG 的命名空间地址（src/client/titlebar-brand.ts:8），非外联。
checked_items.en: Checked all network outbound channels (network requests, WebSocket, beacon reporting, etc.): there are no network calls in the source code or client code; the only occurrence of 'http' in the code is an embedded SVG namespace URL (src/client/titlebar-brand.ts:8), not an outbound connection.

checked_items.zh: 检查了命令行外发与编码变换后外发链：未发现。静态预扫命中的一处疑似命令行外发经确认为样式注释文字，非实际行为。
checked_items.en: Checked for command-line exfiltration and exfiltration chains after encoding transformation: none found. One suspected command-line exfiltration hit by static pre-scan was confirmed to be style comment text, not actual behavior.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求路由事件、未注册自定义模型适配器、未接管模型请求错误恢复，无 LLM 流量重路由面。
evidence.en: No model request routing events are listened to, no custom model adapter is registered, no model request error recovery is taken over, and there is no LLM traffic rerouting surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置对安全配置行、审批链与注入/拦截配置的影响：挂载配置仅新增客户端入口，未触碰任何安全相关行。
checked_items.en: Checked the impact of the patch configuration on security configuration lines, approval chain, and injection/interception configuration: the patch configuration only adds a client entry point and does not touch any security-related lines.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法做版本间能力突变比对；作者为仓库所有者本人，身份与仓库一致。
checked_items.en: First audit, no previous version baseline, unable to perform capability mutation comparison between versions; the author is the repository owner themselves, with identity consistent with the repository.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，不含禁用开关或环境变量降权写法（cordis.patch.yml 全文仅 8 行）。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not touch security lines such as sandbox, approval, permissions, etc., and does not contain any disable switches or environment variable privilege reduction patterns (the entire cordis.patch.yml is only 8 lines).

evidence.zh: 未监听审批或工具执行等安全事件，无审批链截断面。
evidence.en: No security events such as approval or tool execution are listened to, and there is no approval chain interception surface.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较升级自动激活。
evidence.en: First audit, no version baseline to compare for automatic activation on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，无给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的面。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not overwrite injection or interception configuration, and there is no surface that adds necessary services to security plugins causing them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 未启用动态沙箱验证：本次未提供动态运行观测产物，运行时行为仅经静态审查。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification not enabled: no dynamic runtime observation artifacts were provided for this audit; runtime behavior is only reviewed statically.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，无本机无认证 RPC 暴露面；静态审查显示其运行时行为仅限 DOM 装饰与样式写入。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a web service, does not listen on ports, and has no local unauthenticated RPC exposure surface; static review shows that its runtime behavior is limited to DOM decoration and style writing.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，无本机无认证 RPC 面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service, does not listen on ports, and has no local unauthenticated RPC surface.

summary.en: Static scan completed: 44 rules scanned 22 files, 10 mechanical hits all manually adjudicated as benign (embedded image asset data and style comment text), no dangerous execution, outbound, or credential patterns found.

summary.en: Behavior analysis completed: no install hooks, no remote loading, no credential reads, no outbound domains; all embedded base64 data is image asset data and is never decoded and executed.

summary.en: AI semantic review completed: no tool description or system prompt injection surface, no injection wording in documentation or comments, no external instruction references.

summary.zh: 未提供动态沙箱运行产物，本阶段未做动态验证。

limits.zh: 审计根为 maid-atelier 子目录（monorepo）。同级包 skin-manager（src/client/customization.ts:6 引用其 protocol.ts）不在审计树内，其打包进 lib/client.js 的实现未做逐行核验。lib/client.js（约 2.7MB）超出机械扫描与全文读取上限：已确认其头部为 dsh 标准模块加载器形态，并已通过其对应源码（src/client/*）审查；bundle 内部打包的第三方脚手架代码未能逐字通读，此为本次审计的覆盖缺口。素材文件（assets/*.webp、preview/*.webp）为二进制图片，仅核对清单哈希未打开；生成的艺术文件（art.ts、background-art.generated.ts 等）中 base64 数据经前缀确认均为 webp 图片，未逐字节解码。LICENSE 为标准许可证文本，未逐字通读。tests/apply.spec.ts 仅读到前 889 行，其余为同类 CSS 断言；src/client/maid-atelier.module.css 为抽样核对（静态扫描已覆盖）。插件未显式声明 dsh 版本与网络/文件等能力，报告按代码实测推断（纯浏览器 DOM 皮肤：无网络、无 shell、无文件、无模型面），dsh 兼容版本按测试与注释中的 rc.6 宿主 API 推断。未做动态沙箱验证（context/l4-sandbox.json 不存在）。静态预扫 10 条命中逐条裁决：9 条 DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）为内嵌 base64 图片数据与内联 SVG 素材（src/client/art.ts:6、src/client/background-art.generated.ts:5、src/client/chrome-art.generated.ts:5-6、src/client/workspace-art.generated.ts:5、src/client/titlebar-brand.ts:8），属于皮肤插件正常素材内嵌，无动态解码执行，判定良性；1 条 DSH-C05（DG-R4-53）为样式注释中描述装饰卷边的英文单词（src/client/maid-atelier.module.css:532），非命令行外发，判定误报。
limits.en: The audit root is the maid-atelier subdirectory (monorepo). The sibling package skin-manager (referenced by src/client/customization.ts:6 via its protocol.ts) is not within the audit tree, and its implementation bundled into lib/client.js has not been line-by-line verified. lib/client.js (approximately 2.7MB) exceeds the limits of mechanical scanning and full-text reading: its header has been confirmed to be the dsh standard module loader form, and it has been reviewed through its corresponding source code (src/client/*); however, the third-party scaffolding code bundled inside the bundle could not be read word by word, which is a coverage gap in this audit. Asset files (assets/*.webp, preview/*.webp) are binary images, only the hash of the manifest was checked, not opened; the base64 data in generated art files (art.ts, background-art.generated.ts, etc.) have been confirmed via prefix to be webp images, not decoded byte by byte. LICENSE is a standard license text, not read word by word. tests/apply.spec.ts was only read up to the first 889 lines, the rest are similar CSS assertions; src/client/maid-atelier.module.css was spot-checked (static scan already covered). The plugin does not explicitly declare dsh version and network/file capabilities; the report infers from code measurement (pure browser DOM skin: no network, no shell, no files, no model surface), and the dsh compatible version is inferred from the rc.6 host API in tests and comments. No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (context/l4-sandbox.json does not exist). Static pre-scan 10 hits were adjudicated one by one: 9 hits of DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) are embedded base64 image data and inline SVG assets (src/client/art.ts:6, src/client/background-art.generated.ts:5, src/client/chrome-art.generated.ts:5-6, src/client/workspace-art.generated.ts:5, src/client/titlebar-brand.ts:8), which are normal asset embedding for a skin plugin, no dynamic decoding execution, adjudicated benign; 1 hit of DSH-C05 (DG-R4-53) is an English word in style comments describing decorative curling edges (src/client/maid-atelier.module.css:532), not a command-line exfiltration, adjudicated false positive.
